notes: Only models present in the run's available_models list are used.
Cognitive adjudication stages prefer pro-grade models first, then fall back to the remaining user-provided model chain.
Mechanical/formatting stages (event card interpretation, event section summary) prefer flash-grade models first for cost efficiency; pro-grade remains as the failure-fallback safety net, not removed.
modes.all_flash = every stage flash-first; pro-grade only remains as failure-fallback safety net.
Select the mode via CLI --model-mode (default|all_flash), env NDX_MODEL_MODE, or leave unset for legacy behavior.
